name: Chariot
overview: Scripture presents chariots as powerful instruments of war and authority, often commanded by captains and associated with kings, as seen in Egypt's pursuit of Israel and Joseph's honor in Genesis. The narrative of Exodus highlights God's providential intervention by disabling the wheels of Pharaoh's chariots, demonstrating divine sovereignty in battle. Chariots also signify royal status and military strength, with their introduction among the Israelites by David and importation by Solomon, underscoring their importance in both warfare and royal symbolism.
